Proximal Policy Optimization: trains the policy and value layers on the environment.

Stable-Baselines3's PPO: collects steps per copy from every copy, estimates advantages with GAE, then updates both networks for several epochs of minibatches with the clipped objective (Adam, eps 1e-5). Optionally normalises observations and rewards as VecNormalize does. The defaults are SB3's; Tuned for loads RL Zoo's values for the environment.

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Run | Total steps | `total_timesteps` | Integer | `100000` | `1-1000000000` | The run | Environment steps to train for, over all copies (total_timesteps) Required. |
| Run | Stop at a mean return | `stop_at_return` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Stop early once the last 100 episodes average the target. |
| Run | Target return | `target_return` | Number | `475` |   | The run | Mean return of the last 100 episodes that stops the run. |
| Run | Seed | `seed` | Integer | `1` | `0-2147483647` | The run | Seeds the copies, the network weights, the actions and the minibatches (seed) |
| Rollout | Steps per copy | `n_steps` | Integer | `2048` | `1-1000000` | The run | Steps from every copy in one rollout (n_steps) Required. |
| Rollout | Discount | `gamma` | Number | `0.99` | `0-1` | The run | Discount of future rewards (gamma) |
| Rollout | GAE lambda | `gae_lambda` | Number | `0.95` | `0-1` | The run | GAE lambda: bias against variance of the advantages (gae_lambda) |
| Update | Epochs | `n_epochs` | Integer | `10` | `1-1000` | The run | Passes over each rollout (n_epochs) Required. |
| Update | Minibatch size | `batch_size` | Integer | `64` | `1-1000000` | The run | Steps in one minibatch (batch_size) Required. |
| Update | Learning rate | `learning_rate` | Number | `0.0003` |   | The run | Adam's learning rate, eps 1e-5 (learning_rate) Required. |
| Update | Clip range | `clip_range` | Number | `0.2` |   | The run | How far one update may move the policy (clip_range) |
| Update | Value clip | `clip_range_vf` | Number | `0` |   | The run | Clip of the value change; 0 is off (clip_range_vf) |
| Update | Entropy weight | `ent_coef` | Number | `0` |   | The run | Weight of the entropy bonus (ent_coef) |
| Update | Value weight | `vf_coef` | Number | `0.5` |   | The run | Weight of the value loss (vf_coef) |
| Update | Max gradient norm | `max_grad_norm` | Number | `0.5` |   | The run | Clip of the gradient norm over both networks; 0 is off (max_grad_norm) |
| Update | Normalise advantages | `normalize_advantage` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Normalise the advantages of each minibatch (normalize_advantage) |
| Normalise | Observations | `normalize_observations` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Running mean and variance of the observations, as VecNormalize (norm_obs) |
| Normalise | Rewards | `normalize_rewards` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Rewards scaled by the running deviation of the return, as VecNormalize (norm_reward) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Support

| Aspect | Value | Supported | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Workflow Lane | reinforcement learning | Yes | GraphCompiler compiles the RL graph and the Engine's PPO (core/rl) trains it on the environment's copies; PipelineExecutor and the supervised trainer do not run it. |
| Implementation Owner | rl trainer | Yes | As above |
| Support State | real | Yes | As above |
